name: enable_party_damage

stack.evidence: func_001EBCD0 does not access or change the Script value stack

notes: func_001EBCD0 iterates registered class-3 objects, selects the party-character archetype range 0 through 9 returned by func_001239D8, and queues operation types 0x23 and 0x2A for each. Both types map to embedded DAMAGE_ON entries and clear the corresponding damage-disable flags. This is the inverse of command 593 disable_party_damage. The JP corpus contains 144 calls; 78 immediately follow command 150 enable_all_object_control, and 53 have an earlier command 593 in the same entry.
